package.name: @nestjs/platform-bun
package.description: Experimental, unofficial Bun-native HTTP adapter for NestJS, ported from @nestjs/platform-node 12.3.3 onto Bun.serve()
package.author: Yoann Gendrey (https://github.com/iiAku)

scripts.lint: sh scripts/bun-canary.sh lint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --max-warnings 0 src && sh scripts/bun-canary.sh lint --max-warnings 0 src test benchmark
scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script src test/native test/transport test/support test/benchmark 'benchmark/**/*.{ts,mjs}'
